undeclared.decision: Any single retained task token matching a path or any function name promotes the entire file to a task target; every supported finding in that file or a reached import file is accepted without matching its finding scope to the relevant caller.
undeclared.why_it_matters: This makes candidate-task-and-source-evidence-match mean lexical file co-location, including evidence from a separate protected caller. The declared local-import limitation does not disclose this same-file scope substitution. On the actual listener source, moving subscription.js to listen before connect and rescanning still chooses D solely from channel.js/observeChannel, which is called by the metrics consumer that the task says not to change.

stale_rows.stated: D only for task-matched symptoms with corresponding concrete source findings; otherwise A.
stale_rows.actual: Concrete evidence is checked, but a finding can be accepted merely because another function in its file matches the task. The existing listener corpus contains a directly reproducible separate-caller example.

stale_rows.stated: Report partial required/forbidden checks and regressions separately.
stale_rows.actual: The replay discards the missing-check identities and emits only per-arm missing counts and selected-arm forbidden count. It does not report per-check gains/losses or both baseline forbidden counts, so its linked CSV cannot expose all actual partial-effect regressions.

material_issues.issue: File co-location is silently accepted as sufficient task/source relevance.
material_issues.reproduction: Read the frozen listener-registration-order-vanilla sources, swap the two statements in subscription.js so addEventListener precedes connect, run analyze_sources on this in-memory snapshot, then decide with the original task. The only remaining connect-before-listen finding is channel.js/<module>/observeChannel, yet action remains D. createPresenceChannel anchors channel.js; the presence caller does not invoke observeChannel, while metrics-consumer.js does. No project source was changed for this check.
material_issues.requested_resolution: Make the relevance criterion explicit in the ledger and constrain or abstain on this demonstrated disjoint-caller case before claiming aligned source evidence; retain the lexical-analysis qualification.

material_issues.issue: Count-only partial-effect reporting hides an observed within-row regression.
material_issues.evidence: For transfer-progress-composition-v4-vanilla, gpt-5.6-terra/low, selected A has 3 missing effects versus D with 4. A gains accepted-after-hide and composed-reverse-cleanup-switch but loses frame-in-order. The current replay CSV shows only 3 versus 4 and cannot communicate this tradeoff. Across all six fallback rows, there are 7 check gains and 7 check losses versus D, despite equal aggregate missing counts. All observed forbidden lists are empty in the present dataset.
material_issues.requested_resolution: Preserve A/D/selected missing and forbidden check identities and report gained/lost checks per row, with the comparison baseline named, so the existing aggregate claim is accompanied by its actual tradeoffs.
